patch.summary:
Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Bright Data's shape. Choose Bright Data only if your buying job matches “Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments fro” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage: AppDynamics leans observability-monitoring; Bright Data leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Bright Data is Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments from ~$499/mo..

- Workflow coverage skew: AppDynamics-leaning observability-monitoring vs Bright Data-leaning web-data-collection.
